text: Major Ethan Gates leads a covert team to Edolus to seize a Vemus Star Probe before the enemy can use it to create a powerful new Alpha commander. The mission could save the Kevoryn resistance, but the Vemus have anticipated his forces and the advantages he brings. With a captive Vemus construct among his most dangerous assets, Ethan must confront an enemy prepared to turn his own strengths against him.
author: Ken Lozito
